topThreats.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added two security flaws impacting Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following active exploitation in the wild. topThreats.title: CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
